title: European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2021
claims: The 2021 ERC guidelines set out the European approach to basic life support and the chain of survival.
They emphasise early recognition, calling emergency services and early defibrillation by bystanders.
They describe dispatch centres as able to guide callers through recognition and immediate response.
Start CPR in any person who is unresponsive with absent or abnormal breathing; slow, laboured agonal breathing counts as cardiac arrest, and breathing is assessed for no more than 10 seconds.
Compress the adult chest to a depth of at least 5 cm but not more than 6 cm, at a rate of 100-120 per minute, allowing complete chest-wall recoil after each compression.
Rescue breathing alternates 30 compressions and 2 rescue breaths; untrained rescuers may give compression-only CPR at 100-120 per minute.

When the AED arrives, switch it on and attach the pads to the bare chest, continue CPR while attaching, follow the spoken/visual prompts, ensure nobody touches the victim during analysis and shock, press the shock button if advised, then immediately resume CPR; if no shock is advised, resume CPR.
Continue CPR until an AED or defibrillator arrives; do not delay defibrillation once the device is ready, and there is a period of CPR, commonly about 2 minutes, before the next rhythm analysis.

claimVerification.note: BLS：start CPR in any unresponsive person with absent or abnormal breathing；agonal breathing counts；look/listen/feel for breathing for no more than 10 seconds。
BLS：depth at least 5 cm but not more than 6 cm；rate 100-120 min-1；complete recoil, do not lean。
BLS：alternate 30 compressions and 2 rescue breaths；untrained/unable → continuous compressions-only at 100-120 min-1。

BLS AED 段：switch on, attach pads to bare chest, continue CPR while attaching, follow prompts, nobody touching during analysis/shock, push shock button as directed, immediately resume CPR; no shock → resume CPR。
BLS：continue CPR until AED arrives; do not delay defibrillation once ready; commonly 2 min CPR before next analysis。
